records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net product sales were $230,614 in third quarter 2025 compared to $223,891 in third quarter 2024, an increase of $6,723 or 3.0%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Nine months 2025 net product sales were $530,325 compared to $524,174 in nine months 2024, an increase of $6,151 or 1.2%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decrease in cash flows from operating activities reflects improvements during the fourth quarter of 2024 in working capital management, primarily related to inventory and accounts receivable, that accelerated seasonal networking capital benefits.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company continued to face some challenges in nine months 2025 as customers and consumers became more resistant to higher prices, and these headwinds had some adverse effect on sales in nine months 2025.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The effects of the favorable changes in management’s estimates of certain sales allowances, discounts, and promotions in the prior year 2024 comparative periods, as discussed above, have an adverse effect when compared to third quarter and nine months 2025 adjusted operating earnings.
